sermon.title: Jesus, God's Chosen Champion
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer presents Jesus as God’s chosen champion and man of war. From Psalm 2 he shows the Father setting his King over governments that oppose him and giving him the nations, and from Daniel the empires that fell and the stone that became a mountain—the church—filling the earth. Comparing America to Rome, he says the church can still grow and America is not doomed.

faqs.question: What does “mighty man” in Isaiah 42:13 mean?
faqs.answer: Champion—the same word used of Goliath.

faqs.question: Who is the King of glory?
faqs.answer: The Lord strong and mighty in battle—Jesus.

faqs.question: What is Zion?
faqs.answer: A stronghold in Jerusalem, and also the church (Hebrews 12).

faqs.question: Can we know when Christ returns?
faqs.answer: No—it is not for us to know the times or seasons.

faqs.question: Does Jesus destroy the nations?
faqs.answer: He inherits them, breaking and remaking them.

faqs.question: What is the stone in Daniel 2?
faqs.answer: Jesus, whose kingdom becomes a mountain filling the earth.

faqs.question: Will Christians go through tribulation?
faqs.answer: He says yes, and God’s people will be delivered.

faqs.question: Are wars and earthquakes signs of the end?
faqs.answer: He says no—Jesus said the end is not yet.

faqs.question: Does God still do miracles?
faqs.answer: Yes—he says God healed him of valley fever.

faqs.question: Is America doomed?
faqs.answer: No—he says God has another move and time of refreshing.
